title: Restriction compatibility of external section comparisons
statement: Let k be a field [def-weil-field], f:X→Spec(k) and g:Y→Spec(k) schemes [def-pc-scheme], and F,G module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Put M=Gamma(X,F) with its k-action. There is a natural morphism c from the presheaf V↦M tensor_k Gamma(V,G) to the pushforward by pr_2 of the scalar section sheaf of pr_1*F tensor pr_2*G. At the top open it equals the canonical external tensor map [def-sc-scalar-global-sections-comparison]. For every open V of Y there are source and target section isomorphisms identifying c_V with that canonical map for X and the open subscheme V and G restricted to V. No cover or bijectivity hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: Use the explicit component family externalSectionsComponent and its naturality from [lem-sc-external-sections-components] as the app and naturality fields of a Lean natural transformation. No existential choice of a component family is used.

At the top open, externalSectionsTopIso is the section map of the equality preimage_top. Test on pure tensors. The first factor is definitionally tensorPullbackTopSection; for the second, the additional restriction from preimage_top to top is the identity. PresheafOfModules.map_id gives the normalization equation with externalGlobalSectionsTensor.

For each open V apply externalSectionsComponent_openComparison to this same explicitly defined component. Its source and target are definitionally the two evaluations in the required local square. Assemble the natural transformation, normalization equation, and local comparison witnesses with the existential and conjunction constructors.

theorem exists_externalSectionsRestrictionComparison
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    (F : X.Modules) (G : Y.Modules) :
    ∃ c : scalarPresheaf g G ⋙
        MonoidalCategory.tensorLeft (scalarObj f F (op ⊤)) ⟶
        externalSectionsPushforward f g F G,
      c.app (op ⊤) ≫ (externalSectionsTopIso f g F G).hom =
        ModuleCat.ofHom (externalGlobalSectionsTensor f g F G) ∧
      ∀ V : Y.Opens,
        ∃ eS : (scalarPresheaf g G ⋙
            MonoidalCategory.tensorLeft (scalarObj f F (op ⊤))).obj (op V) ≅
            ModuleCat.of k (scalarObj f F (op ⊤) ⊗[k]
              scalarObj (V.ι ≫ g) (G.restrict V.ι) (op ⊤)),
        ∃ eT : (externalSectionsPushforward f g F G).obj (op V) ≅
            scalarObj (pullback.fst f (V.ι ≫ g) ≫ f)
              (externalCupCoefficients f (V.ι ≫ g) F (G.restrict V.ι)) (op ⊤),
          c.app (op V) ≫ eT.hom = eS.hom ≫
            ModuleCat.ofHom
              (externalGlobalSectionsTensor f (V.ι ≫ g) F (G.restrict V.ι))
